title: Customer Invoice report cannot be downloaded without Invoicing & payments - View
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A17 Clerk) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • {User-B}'s role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A17 No Invoices) has Reports on and Invoicing & payments - View off.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A17 Fleet) has an invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234) at {Location-A}, dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026), created by an Admin.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Look for Customer Invoice in the list of reports.
  3. If Customer Invoice is listed, choose it.
  4. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  5. Click Download.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Customer Invoice may or may not be listed; either is acceptable, because the rule is enforced when the file is requested, not by hiding the entry.
  • Steps 3 to 5: no Customer Invoice file is downloaded. If Customer Invoice was not listed, write that in the result comment and pass these steps.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, Story 3 prerequisites, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board covers the report permission; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-013; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD Story 3 prerequisites: “Downloading the report requires Invoicing & payments - View. The gate is enforced on the server, not by hiding the entry in the Export Reports dialog.”
  • Tech plan FR-013: “Report money masking unchanged; line text never masked; report stays gated server-side by `ROLE_INVOICE_VIEW` (S3-R10, prerequisites).”
